title: Entries already in the books keep their stored line memos (nothing is rewritten); a manual journal's own line memos are unchanged
Journal Entry › Interbank transfer (server): one entry, debit the receiving bank and credit the paying bank; refused for a non-bank account, the same account twice or unequal lines
The statement line in each bank links to that transfer journal entry (Match and Post › Interbank transfer finds it); nothing new is posted
A manual journal entry posted to the bank GL and an unposted bank line of the same amount are found by Reconcile Account; matching them posts nothing and clears both from the reconciling items
The book balance on Reconcile Account is the live General Ledger balance: a journal entry posted to the bank GL changes it at once
Interbank transfer of two unposted lines (chequing out, savings in): one entry covers both; each bank moves by the amount; trial balance balances
Interbank transfer to the clearing account: the line posts to 1070 Interbank Transfer Clearing with no tax
Menus: General ledger has one "Journal Entry" (no separate Journal Entries or Expense Vouchers); Banking has no Bank Transfers; GIFI Report is under Reports › Tax Reports and not under General ledger
